title: Low-Latency Asynchronous Logic Design for Inference at the Edge
new_feature: Self-timed, early-propagative dual-rail (QDI) asynchronous circuit for the TM inference datapath (clause evaluation, population count, 1-of-3 encoded magnitude comparator) with a reduced completion-detection scheme; ~10x lower average latency than synchronous at similar area and functional from 0.25-1.2 V supply.
